title: Finding Middle C
description: Your very first exercise: locate middle C (the C nearest the keyhole) and play it with the right thumb, then the left thumb, holding each note for a full count of four.

arrangements.label: Beginner
arrangements.notes: Only middle C is used: whole notes in each hand, then halves and alternating quarters so you learn to count rests as carefully as notes.
teachingPoints: Find middle C by its place just left of the two black keys in the middle of the keyboard.
Bars 1-2: right thumb, count 1-2-3-4 and hold the key down the whole bar; bars 3-4: left thumb does the same.
Bars 5-7: the hands take turns - lift exactly when the rest begins so the other hand can take over.
Keep the wrist level and the thumb curved; play from the side of the thumb, not flat.
